summary: Proem Acquisition Corp. I (Nasdaq: PAAC), a Cayman blank-check company, signed a merger agreement on September 26, 2026 with Astro Digital US, Inc., a Delaware aerospace firm providing modular satellite infrastructure and mission-support services. Structure: PAAC domestication to Delaware, then a forward merger of Merger Sub I into Astro Digital followed immediately by a second merger into Merger Sub II, with the combined entity renamed Astro Digital, Inc. PAAC's board unanimously approved and recommends the deal. Selling stockholders agreed to lock-up arrangements. No price per share or valuation disclosed in the excerpt; watch redemption levels, D&O and closing conditions.
